# Pull request

## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

Describe the checks you ran and their results. For hardware changes, distinguish
mock tests from physical observations. Include screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Applicable tests and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] New UI strings are present in all three translation catalogs, if applicable.
- [ ] No personal data, credentials, raw device captures or local build files are included.
- [ ] Hardware protection and restoration behavior are preserved, if applicable.
